_comment: The intent corpus, copied from spike/fixtures/corpus/corpus.json -- the spike manifest is the source of truth and this is its test-set copy, because a spec must not reach outside its own package. `verdict` is the semantically correct verdict; `ruleVerdict` is what ADR-010's positional rule produces, stated separately so the spec asserts BOTH the rule's output AND that its cost set is exactly the class ADR-010 claims.
